parsed.scene_description: The photo shows the interior of a small shop or convenience store with glass doors leading outside. Shelves stocked with beverages and packaged goods line the right side. A table with items sits near the left door. Bright daylight illuminates the scene from outside, revealing palm trees and a bench in the background.

objects.label: glass doors
objects.observation: Double glass doors with metal handles are centered in the frame. They lead to an outdoor area with palm trees and a bench visible through them. The doors have a green 'EXIT' sign above them. The exterior is brightly lit, causing glare.

objects.label: shelves with products
objects.observation: Metal shelves on the right wall hold various packaged goods, including milk cartons and jars. The shelves are well-stocked and illuminated by overhead lights. Products are arranged neatly on multiple levels.

objects.label: table with items
objects.observation: A dark-colored table stands near the left door, holding a bag, a bottle, and other miscellaneous items. It is positioned close to the entrance and partially obstructs the view of the doorway.

objects.label: outdoor bench
objects.observation: A wooden bench is visible outside through the glass doors, situated on a paved area. Palm trees are behind it, indicating a tropical or warm climate setting. The bench is clearly visible against the bright background.

objects.label: overhead lighting
objects.observation: Fluorescent light fixtures hang from the ceiling above the entrance and shelves. They illuminate the interior space evenly. The lights are mounted directly to the ceiling structure.
